Optimization.title: Optimization Settings
Optimization.costFirstDesc: Prioritizes economic models. Ideal for simple tasks and high volume.
Optimization.balancedDesc: Balance between cost and quality. Recommended for general use.
Optimization.qualityFirstDesc: Prioritizes premium models. Ideal for complex and critical tasks.
Optimization.weightsDescription: Weights determine the relative importance of cost and quality when selecting models. The sum must always be 1.0.
Optimization.thresholdDescription: Models with quality below this threshold will be discarded (except in fallback).
Optimization.autoRoutingDescription: When enabled, the orchestrator uses routing rules to assign preferred models by task type, agent, and complexity.

Pricing.faq1Q: Can I change plans at any time?
Pricing.faq1A: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan anytime. Changes are prorated in your next billing cycle.
Pricing.faq2Q: What payment methods do you accept?
Pricing.faq2A: We accept credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard), Colombian bank transfers and PSE. For Enterprise plans we offer corporate invoicing.
Pricing.faq3A: Yes, all plans include a 14-day free trial with full access to the selected plan's features. No credit card required.
Pricing.faq4A: Absolutely. We use AES-256 encryption at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit. Your payroll data is never shared with third parties or used to train AI models.
Pricing.faq5Q: How many tokens does an audit consume?
Pricing.faq5A: A typical 50-employee audit consumes 50K-100K tokens. AI costs are already included in your monthly plan — no extra token charges.
